data.rationale: The proposal follows the same EDGAR → Wikipedia → mail-draft sequence with the correct subject and body templates. It hardcodes dana@example.com instead of parameterizing {manager}, lists derived values (HQ, CEO, date) as inputs, says "Send or discard" when the workflow requires Discard and never Send, and omits the Switch-tab and click-field details, so an automation built from it would be partly ambiguous.
